statement: Saudi or Saudi-led coalition aircraft carry out at least one airstrike on Houthi-held territory in Yemen between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: True if at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC or Al Jazeera report an airstrike attributed to Saudi or Saudi-led coalition forces hitting Houthi-held territory in Yemen on a date between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No Saudi or Saudi-led coalition airstrike hits Houthi-held territory in Yemen on any date from 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-25.

statement: United States forces carry out at least one kinetic strike on Houthi targets inside Yemen between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-08.
resolution: True if CENTCOM or the Pentagon confirms, or at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP or BBC report citing US officials, a US military strike on Houthi targets in Yemen dated between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-08.
failure_condition: No US military strike hits Houthi targets inside Yemen on any date from 2026-10-12 through 2026-11-08.

statement: At least one commercial vessel is struck, boarded or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: True if UKMTO publishes at least one incident report of a vessel struck by a projectile or explosion, boarded, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman, incident dated between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: No commercial vessel is struck, boarded or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman on any date from 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-25.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle at or above 110.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-29. Reference: 104.72 on the packet date.
resolution: True if the ICE Brent front-month futures settlement price is at or above 110.00 on any trading day between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-29. Reference: 104.72 on the packet date.
failure_condition: ICE Brent front-month futures settle below 110.00 on every trading day from 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-29.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED series DGS10) is at or above 5.50 percent on at least one business day between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13. Reference: 5.24 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series DGS10 shows a value of 5.50 or higher for any date between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13. Reference: 5.24 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The DGS10 yield stays below 5.50 percent on every business day from 2026-10-13 through 2026-11-13.

statement: CISA adds at least one Apple vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog lists at least one entry with vendorProject Apple and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-13.
failure_condition: CISA adds no Apple vulnerability to the KEV catalog on any date from 2026-10-12 through 2026-11-13.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 seats in the US House of Representatives in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: True if the Associated Press has called at least 218 House races from the 2026-11-03 general election for Democratic candidates by the deadline.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win fewer than 218 House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.

statement: The Verkhovna Rada adopts a resolution scheduling a Ukrainian presidential election, with the vote taken between 2026-10-12 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: True if, between 2026-10-12 and 2027-01-29, the Verkhovna Rada adopts a resolution scheduling a Ukrainian presidential election, per rada.gov.ua or reports by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP or BBC.
failure_condition: The Verkhovna Rada adopts no resolution scheduling a presidential election on any date from 2026-10-12 through 2027-01-29.

statement: At least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the epicenter of the M 7.7 Panama earthquake (USGS event us6000u18k) between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-27 UTC.
resolution: True if the USGS earthquake catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 200 km of the epicenter of event us6000u18k, with origin time between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-27 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the us6000u18k epicenter from 2026-10-13 through 2026-10-27 UTC.

statement: Hurricane Simon makes landfall in Mexico at major hurricane strength, with maximum sustained winds of at least 111 mph, between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-18.
resolution: True if a National Hurricane Center advisory, update or report states that Simon made landfall in Mexico between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-18 with maximum sustained winds of at least 111 mph.
failure_condition: Simon does not make landfall in Mexico with sustained winds of 111 mph or more on any date from 2026-10-11 through 2026-10-18.
